reason: The original runner computed LLM classification metrics only on non-null predictions while presenting them as if they used all 63 samples.

derivation.abstention_policy: A null category is an abstention and counts as incorrect in full-set accuracy.

limitations: The 2026-07-24 artifact does not retain every sample-level LLM prediction.
Consequently, full-set macro-F1 and weighted-F1 cannot be reconstructed and are deliberately reported as null.
Conditional metrics describe only the 42 answered samples and must always be shown with 66.67% coverage.
